create.name: Renée Morris
create.bio:
Renée Morris is a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner and instructor who also serves as one of the method's ambassadors. She works under the name Oceanica, a small practice she founded to offer energy healing, energy coaching and classes, and her Quantum-Touch directory entry places her in Ottawa, Ontario. She describes a lifelong curiosity about mind, body and soul, and puts self-healing and personal responsibility at the centre of how she works.

Her sessions use Quantum-Touch, in which the practitioner pairs breathing, body awareness and sound to direct life-force energy, and run from half an hour to two hours. People can book in person or at a distance by video call, telephone or written messages. A second format, which she calls The Energy Healing Experience, adds a closing half-hour in which she passes on the impressions she receives through what she terms second sight, along with written notes; she is clear that this part sits outside the Quantum-Touch method itself. She also offers short energy coaching calls and monthly coaching, and teaches the Level 1 Becoming Energized workshop online. With fellow practitioner Shelly L Liedtke she has hosted a weekly video chat series about Quantum-Touch, and she has been a guest on Thea Willette's Quantum Conversations and on Jaime Moar's podcast.

videos.title: Quantum Conversations with Thea Willette - Quantum-Touch

courses.title: Quantum-Touch energy healing sessions
courses.description: One-to-one Quantum-Touch sessions of 30 to 120 minutes, given in person or at a distance by video, phone or written chat. Before the session she asks what the client would like to focus on, and a general session is also possible.

courses.title: The Energy Healing Experience
courses.description: A longer session of 60 to 120 minutes that opens with Quantum-Touch and closes with half an hour of intuitive feedback from what she calls second sight. Clients also receive written notes of the impressions she shares.

courses.title: Energy coaching
courses.description: Coaching calls aimed at shifting your energy around a situation, pattern or relationship. Available as single 30- or 60-minute calls, a month of weekly calls with messaging check-ins, or check-ins alone.
courses.price: $75 (30 minutes); $125 (60 minutes); $300 (one month of coaching); $200 (one month of weekly check-ins)
